facts.text: The upstream is an MCP server for controlling a Keysight/Agilent oscilloscope over Ethernet
The tested oscilloscope is the Agilent MSOX2024A with firmware 02.43.2018020635
The constructor opens a VISA resource TCPIP0::<ip>::inst0::INSTR through pyvisa's pure-Python ResourceManager '@py'
The VISA session uses a newline read terminator and a newline write terminator
query sends a SCPI query and strips the reply; write sends SCPI text and ignores a blank command
reset sends *RST and then *CLS
run, stop, single and autoscale write :RUN, :STOP, :SINGle and :AUToscale
set_timebase writes :TIMebase:SCALe in seconds per division and set_timebase_delay writes :TIMebase:DELay in seconds
get_timebase reads the scale in seconds per division, the delay in seconds and the timebase mode
set_channel configures the channel scale in V/div, offset in V, coupling AC|DC|GND, display and bandwidth limit
get_channel reads the channel scale, offset, coupling, display and bandwidth limit
set_trigger writes the trigger mode and, in edge mode, the edge source, slope and level in volts
get_trigger reads the trigger mode, edge source, level in volts, slope and sweep
The automatic measurement names are frequency, period, vpp, vrms, vmax, vmin, vaverage, duty, rise, fall, overshoot, preshoot and width
A measurement above the no-measurement threshold is reported as 'no_signal'
get_waveform requests an IEEE 488.2 binary block from :WAVeform:DATA? and returns time and voltage arrays
get_serial_data arms a single acquisition, polls :OPERegister:CONDition? up to 100 times, breaking when the RUN bit (bit 3) clears, then reads the lister as an IEEE 488.2 block
screenshot reads the display as a PNG binary block from :DISPlay:DATA?
get_state returns the identity, timebase, trigger and channels 1 to 4
The MCP tool schema restricts the channel to 1, 2, 3 and 4
The MCP trigger tool restricts the slope to positive, negative or either
